title: filenode-server: external authorizer hook mapping Space roles to FilesRights
description: External authorizer hook mapping Space roles to FilesRights (filenode L146-163); scope FileNode/changes by Space access (L142). Uses the role permission union incl. @everyone (chat-00 conformance resolver).
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests: role->rights mapping table quoted from L146-163; changes hidden for non-members (L142).
notes:
Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: Option B. view->mayRead; send->+mayAddChildren; manage_channels->+mayDelete,+mayRename (non-root),+mayModifyContent; manage_space->+mayShare,+mayRename on root. Implement per the bead's planned fail-open files_rights hook in filenode-server + space_files_rights in chat-filenode-server. New rights (e.g. maySetMetadata, lu95.5) default to the manage_channels tier unless spec says otherwise.

Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[chat-ext] Space FilesRights table and shareWith rule (spec now normative)
Spec (ff6b3b9): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md L161-168: "For Space members, the following table maps role permissions to the `FilesRights` flags ({{JMAP-FILENODE}}) the server reports in `myRights` and enforces ... `mayModifyContent` is `false` on a Directory, including the tree root. | Member with `\"view\"` | `mayRead` ... | `\"send\"` | ... plus `mayAddChildren` | `\"manage_channels\"` | ... plus `mayDelete`, `mayRename`, and `mayModifyContent` on every node except the tree root | `\"manage_space\"` | The above, plus `mayDelete` and `mayRename` on the tree root |"; L170: "No role is granted `mayShare`. ... the server rejects a `FileNode/set` update that changes `shareWith` on a node in a Space file tree with a `forbidden` SetError."; L176: "Creating the Space file tree root ... requires `\"manage_space\"` permission, and so, by the table above, does destroying it."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server/src/lib.rs (no rights hook; only check_root_create at :108 and resolve_filenode_attachment at :425); crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs (no files_rights hook; no shareWith gate); crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/filenode.rs:125-136 FilesRights fields
Now: Not implemented. No per-Space myRights derivation, no destroy-root gate, and shareWith on Space-tree nodes is accepted.
Change: Implement per JMAP-v9py.16.4 with the spec table: no mayShare for any role; manage_space adds mayDelete as well as mayRename on the root; mayModifyContent is false on directories; mayAddChildren is false where children are impossible. Reject shareWith changes on Space-tree nodes with forbidden. See decisions_needed.
Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION (supersedes earlier mayShare choice): follow chat-filenode-00 at 6bcd9d8 L161-176 exactly. No role gets mayShare; shareWith change on a Space-tree node -> forbidden; manage_space gets mayRename+mayDelete on root; manage_channels +mayDelete,+mayRename,+mayModifyContent on non-root; any flag no row grants (incl. future maySetMetadata) is false.
